verdict.rationale: The pack confirms FIDO2 support and passwordless login, but no item documents a FIDO2 PIN, client PIN, or built-in biometric for on-device user verification. The only related control is OpenPGP touch confirmation, which is a user-presence check, not user verification, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a security engineer, the key supports on-device user verification — a FIDO2 PIN or built-in biometric — so a stolen key alone cannot authenticate
